preconditions: Owner states and state_by_id storage have capacity for Header.definition_count entries and all Definition.id values
every Definition.id is within the state_by_id table
every eligible item index without bit 0x8000 is below 24
child_0 and child_1 are either -1 or valid slot indices; other negative values are not safe
divergence: The candidate preserves the recovered initialization and signed-child semantics but GC/1.3 lowers its pointer-oriented loops to 276 bytes/69 instructions. Retail is 336 bytes/84 instructions, saves r29-r31 in a 0x20-byte frame, carries separate 0x18 and 0x90 byte offset accumulators, repeatedly reloads Owner+0x23C, and uses indexed stores. The candidate saves only r31 in a 0x10-byte frame and retains direct Definition and StateEntry pointers. The item flag boolean lowering and final 0x800000 OR sequence also differ.
